disclaimer: This checklist is an initial planning guide. Requirements, fees, forms and renewal dates can change. Confirm every item with the relevant county office, KRA or national regulator before making a payment.

general_requirements.title: Business registration details
general_requirements.description: Keep the registered business or company name, registration number, owner or director details and physical address ready.
general_requirements.renewal_note: Update whenever ownership, contacts or location changes.
general_requirements.fee_note: No fee estimate is shown until the official source is verified.

general_requirements.title: KRA tax profile
general_requirements.description: Confirm that the business has the appropriate KRA PIN and understands its filing and invoicing obligations.
general_requirements.renewal_note: Tax filing frequency depends on the business tax obligations.
general_requirements.fee_note: Tax amounts are not calculated in this MVP.

requirements.title: Single business permit
requirements.description: A county business permit is commonly required for a shop operating from a physical location.
requirements.renewal_note: Usually reviewed on a recurring county cycle.
requirements.fee_note: Fee depends on county classification and business size.

requirements.title: Public-health and hygiene review
requirements.description: The premises may require inspection for cleanliness, sanitation, waste handling and customer safety.
requirements.renewal_note: Inspection or certification timing depends on county practice.
requirements.fee_note: Confirm the current county inspection and certificate charges.

requirements.title: Food-premises and public-health requirements
requirements.description: Food businesses generally need to demonstrate safe food handling, clean premises, sanitation and suitable storage.
requirements.renewal_note: Check the current inspection and certificate cycle.
requirements.fee_note: Exact charges must come from the responsible county office.

requirements.title: Fire-safety review
requirements.description: The premises may need fire-safety equipment and inspection depending on size, occupancy and county requirements.
requirements.renewal_note: Review whenever equipment or premises arrangements change.

requirements.title: Alcoholic-drinks licence
requirements.description: Alcohol sales normally require a sector-specific county licence, subject to local eligibility, location and inspection rules.
requirements.renewal_note: Applications and renewal windows are set by the county.
requirements.fee_note: Do not rely on an estimate; verify the gazetted fee and licence class.

requirements.title: Workplace, waste and safety requirements
requirements.description: A workshop should plan for safe equipment use, waste-oil handling, fire protection and suitable premises.
requirements.renewal_note: Review after major equipment or premises changes.
requirements.fee_note: Applicable approvals depend on the activity and location.

requirements.title: Property and tax records
requirements.description: Maintain ownership, rental-income, tenant and property records required for tax and local compliance.
requirements.renewal_note: Update records as tenants, income or ownership changes.
requirements.fee_note: The MVP does not calculate tax or property charges.

requirements.title: Professional registration where applicable
requirements.description: Some professional services require individual or firm registration with a sector regulator.
requirements.renewal_note: Renewal depends on the relevant professional regulator.
requirements.fee_note: Confirm directly with the professional body.

requirements.title: Confirm Embu County permit classification
requirements.description: Confirm the correct business category, premises location and current permit requirements with Embu County before payment.
requirements.renewal_note: Use the current Embu County licensing calendar.
requirements.fee_note: Fee intentionally withheld until verified against an official schedule.
